classes.name: ARBs
classes.description: Losartan, valsartan, irbesartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, candesartan, azilsartan (Edarbi); single-agent tablets (combinations with HCTZ or amlodipine are alternatives only if listed separately). Sacubitril/valsartan (Entresto) is heart failure and out of scope.
classes.plainDescription: A daily blood pressure pill, often used when an ACE inhibitor causes cough.

classes.name: Calcium channel blockers
classes.description: Dihydropyridines (amlodipine, nifedipine ER, felodipine ER, nicardipine) and non-dihydropyridines (diltiazem IR/ER, verapamil IR/ER).
classes.plainDescription: A daily blood pressure pill that relaxes blood vessels.

classes.name: Beta blockers
classes.description: Metoprolol tartrate/succinate, carvedilol IR/CR, atenolol, bisoprolol, nebivolol (Bystolic), propranolol IR/ER, labetalol, nadolol.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.

classes.name: Thiazide diuretics
classes.plainDescription: A daily water pill for blood pressure.

preferredAgent.sig: 50 mg once daily (25 mg if volume-depleted or with liver disease); range 25-100 mg/day (label).
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for blood pressure.

records.verificationNote: Searched the full PDL text for hydrochlorothiazide, HCTZ, chlorthalidone, indapamide and metolazone. Single-agent thiazides are absent; atenolol/chlorthalidone (p. 11) is a combination only and is not used as a single-agent alternative. The PDL overview says the list is not a complete covered list, so absence is not treated as nonformulary. Chlorthalidone is a reference pick only. Strength and sig are standard label dosing. [Sonnet check 2026-10-22: noCoveredAgent removed; absence from the PDL means not PDL-managed, not uncovered. Pick changed from chlorthalidone to hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg as the most commonly written thiazide, chlorthalidone moved to alternatives. PDL p.1: 'Not all drugs covered by NYRx are subject to programs included in this document' and 'All drugs currently covered by NYRx ... remain available under the PDP'; the NYRx PDL web page adds 'Not all agents covered by NYRx are listed on the PDL' (newyork.fhsc.com/providers/PDP_about.asp, read 2026-10-22). Coverage not confirmed against the eMedNY list of reimbursable drugs. Partial.]
